text:
Jordan (Customer): hey, our integration started throwing 403s after we rotated keys this morning. generation and embeddings both failing. we used the same client code as before, only swapped the API key. seeing `403 Forbidden` with message "missing scope" in the body. any idea?

Maya (CS): sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the truncated key (first/last 4) and your org id? also any request id from the response body would help.

Jordan (Customer): org: org_42ac9, key shows as `sk-****9fA2` in logs. sample curl we ran: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX9fA2" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-base","input":"hi"}'
```
response: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":{"message":"missing scopes: inference:generate, embeddings:create","type":"auth_error"}}

Maya (CS): thanks — that error string nails it. two quick checks: (1) did you provision this key via SSO/SCIM or via the Admin Console? (2) can you confirm the user who created the key had the right role? sometimes orgs that provision keys via SSO have conservative default scopes.

Jordan (Customer): created from SSO provisioning. admin said they clicked "API keys" in the SSO portal and it auto-created a token.

Liam (Platform): likely provisioning flow is not attaching product scopes by default. @Maya can you confirm if this org uses role-mapped keys? I can reproduce locally if needed. quick repro i just did (simulate SSO-provisioned key): 
```
# simulate request that lacks scopes
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-FAKE_NOPERM" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"text-embed-small","input":"x"}'

# expected 403 body
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{\"error\":{\"message\":\"missing scopes: embeddings:create\",\"type\":\"auth_error\"}}
```

Anita (SRE): if we see repeated 403s after key rotation, we need to know whether its misconfiguration or a bug in the SSO sync job. maya — can you ask customer to check Admin Console > API keys page and paste the key row (not the secret) — there should be a Scopes column showing checkboxes (Generation, Embeddings, Rerank).

Maya (CS): Jordan, can you open Admin Console (Settings -> API keys) and screenshot the key row (or tell me which boxes are checked)? if you can't, we can run a quick check from our side with your org id. Also, please confirm if any deny policy exists in your IdP that might strip scopes on creation.

Jordan (Customer): screenshot attached (sent privately). looks like only "Session tokens" was checked, not Generation or Embeddings. I didn't even see Rerank.

Maya (CS): ok that explains it — token lacks required scopes. probable immediate remediation: create a new key from Admin Console and explicitly enable Generation + Embeddings (and Rerank if you use it). then update your deployed secret and rotate gracefully.

Liam (Platform): for ops: suggest we add a guard in the SSO/SCIM provisioning flow that validates at least one of the inference scopes is present, or auto-assigns minimal generation/embeddings scopes when the user requests an API key. Logging action item: PLAT-keys-guard.

Anita (SRE): also create a short runbook snippet we can paste into the customer reply with exact curl checks and the error string they should expect. i'll draft it.

Maya (CS): jordan, proposed reply to customer: "we see your key was created without generation/embeddings scopes; please create a new API key from Admin Console and enable Generation and Embeddings, then redeploy. if you must keep SSO provisioning, we'll escalate to Platform to update the provisioning template so new keys include those scopes by default." want me to make the key for you?

Jordan (Customer): yes please — we can't do a deploy until midday and would appreciate a temporary token. thanks.

Maya (CS): @Liam can you generate a temporary support-scoped key for org_42ac9 with inference:generate + embeddings:create only, TTL 2h? mark as customer-issue-1805556667.

Liam (Platform): on it. creating support key now, will DM secret. generating with CLI: 
```
redwood keys create --org org_42ac9 --scopes inference:generate,embeddings:create --ttl 2h --note "support temp"
# returns secret `sk-zzzzTEMP` (DMed to Maya)
```

auth-bot: automated notice — API key sk-zzzzTEMP created by liam (Platform) for org org_42ac9; scopes: [inference:generate, embeddings:create]; expires in 2h.

Maya (CS): sent secret to Jordan via DM. Jordan let us know once you confirm the new key works and we'll keep this thread open until rotation complete.

Jordan (Customer): confirmed — generation and embeddings now passing. thanks everyone. would still like us to follow up on SSO provisioning default scopes.

Maya (CS): taking follow-up: will open internal ticket to update SSO template and add validation. action items: (1) CS-assign create support runbook (Anita), (2) PLAT-keys-guard (Liam), (3) update Admin Console help text (Maya). tagging #eng-runtime if platform wants to triage deeper.

Anita (SRE): drafting runbook now, will include these snippets: 
```
# quick check for missing scopes
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-base","input":"test"}' | jq .
# look for error.message contains "missing scopes"
```

Maya (CS): closing loop here once platform confirms SSO change plan. Jordan — leave this thread if you need more help, otherwise we'll follow up when template is updated. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Customer): all good for now, thanks again :)
